subject: Re: Generalized rate metrics — kickoff
body:
Hi Dmitri,

Staffing: Fumiko 50% (research lead), Halima 40% (experiments), Oyin 30% (platform API), Gustavo 20% (review). Rafael is our anchor on this: he is committed at 60% to this project through July 2026, covering the pilot integration and the hardening phase after it — I have logged the allocation in the resourcing sheet.

Compute: negligible — these are tabular experiments (COMPAS, Adult), CPU virtualenv jobs. The cost center is engineer time, not accelerators, which is a nice change.

Dependency: the platform API design needs Oyin and the serving folks to agree on where constraint specs live in the training config schema; I will set that review for mid-March.

Deshawn
